title: Saumyendranath Tagore
text: Saumyendranath Tagore (8 October 1901 – 22 September 1974), son of Sudhindranath Tagore, fourth child of Dwijendranath Tagore, and grandnephew of Rabindranath Tagore, was the leader of the Revolutionary Communist Party of India, and the first translator of The Communist Manifesto into Bengali, which was published in Langal magazine edited by Kazi Nazrul Islam.
